origin: Researcher-agent cross-round synthesis after reviewing all 12 independent search proposals and primary prior art. It was not supplied in the initial brief and was not one of the blinded U/E outputs.
discovered_connection: Underserved small-utility reserve coordination plus confidential coupled computation and explicit semantic/output authorization yields a joint planning answer without an aggregate raw-inventory database.
useful_output: One aggregate feasibility bit for the complete preauthorized family of simultaneous claims over supplied eligibility, availability and withheld-owner-reserve constraints.
specific_gap: SPAREConnect documents contact discovery, emergency/nonroutine requests and voluntary bilateral terms, not this pre-emergency coupled answer; GridAssurance supplies dedicated inventory rather than this owner-held-input computation. These distinctions do not prove competitor incapacity or customer demand.
prior_art_boundary: Private coupled resource feasibility is established prior art: SIAM DOI 10.1137/19M127879X.
Prime Match demonstrates production private financial-inventory matching with stronger malicious security.
MPC, Shamir secret sharing and Hall’s theorem are established components, not new inventions.
evidence_of_need: GAO-23-106180 documents limited participation, cost and administrative barriers for smaller utilities. A privacy-sensitive segment and willingness to pay remain explicit hypotheses, not GAO findings.
independent_review: Conditional go for bounded application construction; no world-first, universal foresight or proven-market claim.

transformation_witness.original_purpose: Learn whether cooperation can satisfy every declared simultaneous-reserve requirement before paying for broader disclosure, engineering and contracting.
transformation_witness.restriction: No coordinator may collect all raw private eligibility, availability and retention inputs. Individually eligible matches do not establish simultaneous coverage.
transformation_witness.change: Evaluate joint feasibility through established secret sharing, with a fixed public shape and one authorized output per independent input epoch.
preserved_obligations: Every declared demand and scenario remains; each asset can serve at most one demand within an incident.
Withheld owner assets remain unavailable; the instrument does not invent compatibility or transport access.
No raw inventory is released by the declared computation; participants explicitly authorize its output and metadata.
A negative answer means the supplied evidence does not certify feasibility, not physical impossibility.
acceptance: Actual three-process MPC agrees with an independent cleartext oracle.
A known simultaneous-claim counterexample returns false.
Changing scenario or epoch invalidates the earlier local authorization.
The algorithm has no secret-dependent public branches; released output contains no raw inputs.
falsifiers: Disclosure beyond the authorized function output and declared metadata under the supported threat model.
Omission of a scenario or relaxation of an owner constraint.
A competent incumbent economically supplies the required result to the target segment.
Buyer values, consent or complete costs eliminate viable participation.

rights: Synthetic inputs and new Apache-2.0 code; MPyC is MIT licensed. Public sources are attributed. No real confidential inventory or customer data is used.
next_construction: Actual local three-party execution, strong controls, frozen fresh origin/successor cases, complete modeled economics and existing Nova/FusionPlan/MARK artifact integration.
